facts.heading: Anxiety is constant
facts.content: Hannah feels anxious all the time. Her anxiety has worsened since September.
facts.evidence: I think I'm just anxious all the time, and it's got worse since September.

facts.heading: Made deputy head

facts.evidence: I was made deputy head at my school. I've taught Year 4 for eleven years
